claim_summary: FairAMO contributes a controlled evaluation protocol that compares time-series model orchestrators on identical frozen candidate forecasts and permitted historical evidence before test labels are revealed.

claim_evidence.quote: We introduce FairAMO, a controlled protocol for comparing orchestration methods under identical candidate forecasts, evidence, and evaluation metrics for TSF.

modules.name: Frozen forecast bank protocol
modules.scope_reason: TSK applies because the protocol commits model selection or combination weights and evaluates forecast outputs against forecasting criteria; changing the task family would require redesigning the candidate forecast state, decision output and scoring objective.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - embeds forecasting output and evaluation criteria
R4:Memory and Context; Planning and Orchestration

evidence.quote: Frozen Forecast Bank. All M candidate TSFMs are run once on GIFT-Eval and are never retrained or fine-tuned afterwards. Their outputs are cached in a forecast bank indexed by (dataset, term, series, window, candidate, quantile).
Using only this evidence, it produces an orchestration strategy, either a model selection or a set of combination weights, which is then committed and frozen for the test period.

modules.name: Pool headroom and realization metrics
modules.scope_reason: TSK applies because headroom, gain and realization are computed from forecast losses of candidate models, an oracle and an orchestrator; changing the task family would require changing the output loss and validation criterion.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - embeds forecasting loss and validation criteria

evidence.quote: Gain G = Lbest (P ) − Lmethod (P ) is what a method actually recovers relative to the baseline.
Realization HR = G/H(P ) is the fraction of the available headroom that the method converts into accuracy.

temporal_validity.quote: No rerun, reweighting, or inspection of test scores is permitted after commitment.

task_performance.quote: The strongest deployable orchestrator, TSOrchestra SLSQP, reaches 0.658 MASE, a gain of 0.039 or 5.6% over the best single TSFM, TiRex2, at 0.697.

changes: dimensions: Control, Verification, and Feedback -> Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: The packet supports the same frozen forecast-bank and commit-before-test protocol, but the retired dimension label is replaced and the TSK temporal view is corrected.

changes: dimensions: Control, Verification, and Feedback -> Planning and Orchestration
reconciliation.reason: The packet supports the same separately usable headroom/gain/realization measures; current vocabulary replaces the retired dimension and treats these task-specific metrics as having no embedded temporal function.

notes: The packet evaluates and reimplements prior orchestrators, but those are not new modules contributed by this work. The two retained modules are the controlled forecast-bank protocol and its separate headroom/gain/realization evaluation measures.
